records.title: fix(C08): block parenthesized literal PHP callable bypass
records.body:

- The existing reachable PHP scanner rejects dynamic variable calls but did not reject parenthesized quoted callable expressions such as `('system')('true')` (PHP 8.4 syntax checked, sink NOT executed).

records.title: fix(security): reject parenthesized property and array callback execution
records.body:
## Verified C08 bypass
PHP 8.4.24 executes both `($this->callback)("abc")` and `($callbacks['selected'])("ABC")`; the existing bootstrap-reachable regex rejects only simple `($callback)()` and misses both forms. This remains a conservative static check, **not** comprehensive PHP parsing or runtime proof; broader C08 stays OPEN.
